mentions.name: Book writing tracker
mentions.description: A simple web project that keeps track of a book stored in a single folder of markdown files alongside text-file lists.
mentions.source_excerpt: As this is all in markdown in one folder, with some text files as lists, I started writing a simple web project to keep track of it all.
